Breakdown.Title: Breakdown
Breakdown.NoSources: No source information was recorded for this roll.
Breakdown.Approximate: Contains multiplication or division — individual values are approximate.

Targets.Label: Targets
Targets.FromAttackHits: Use the targets hit by the attack
Targets.FromAttackAll: Use all targets of the attack
Targets.NoAttack: No attack roll found for this damage card.

ShowBreakdown.Name: Show roll breakdown
ShowBreakdown.Hint: Adds a detailed breakdown with the source of every number to attack and damage cards.

ExpandBreakdown.Name: Breakdown always expanded
ExpandBreakdown.Hint: Render the breakdown directly inside the card instead of only in the hover popover.

ShowDiscarded.Name: Show the dropped die
ShowDiscarded.Hint: On advantage or disadvantage the die that was not used is displayed as well.

ShowAdvantageBadge.Name: Show advantage badge
ShowAdvantageBadge.Hint: Always show, directly on the card, whether a roll was made with advantage or disadvantage.

ShowMargin.Name: Show hit margin
ShowMargin.Hint: Show by how much an attack beat or missed the target's AC.

TargetTools.Name: Target tools
TargetTools.Hint: Who may change the recorded targets of a card after the fact.
TargetTools.Owner: Game master and the author of the card

EffectNames.Name: Resolve effect names
EffectNames.Hint: Try to name the active effect or feature behind a bonus instead of only showing "Effects & features".

DamageButton.Name: Damage button on attack cards
DamageButton.Hint: Offer a “Roll damage” button on the attack card, which records the targets the attack hit so the damage can be applied to them from the damage card.
